newsitem.title: USA: Merrill Lynch reports record second quarter profits.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch reports record second quarter profits.

text.p: Merrill Lynch and Co. Inc.'s second quarter net income rose to $481 million, the highest of any quarter in the company's history, eclipsing a mark set just a quarter ago, Merrill said Tuesday.

In topping its first quarter profit of $465 million, the Wall Street brokerage bucked an industry trend. A weak stock market performance early in the second quarter kept many firms from improving over the industry's very strong first quarter.
Net income climbed 11 percent vs. the 1996 second quarter results of $433 million.
Merrill's earnings per share rose to $1.24 vs. $1.09 in last year's second quarter. Net revenues totalled $3.97 billion, up 17.3 percent from $3.38 billion in the same period last year.
The company recorded growth in most of its major businesses, including investment banking, principal transactions and asset management, but revenues from commissions fell 3.3 percent to $1.1 billion.

Compensation and benefit expenses rose 15 percent to $2.0 billion in the quarter, due to higher incentive compensation and staff increases, but compensation costs shrank to 50.5 percent of net revenue, from 51.5 percent last year.
Merrill's first-half earnings of $947 million were also a record, marking a 12.3 percent improvement over $843 million in the first half of 1996.

Total assets in the firm's worldwide accounts reached a record $940 billion at the end of the second quarter, up $184 billion from last year's second quarter and an increase of $72 billion from the end of the first quarter of 1997.
